meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Weekly reserves and daily rates are final on release. Investment flows, ECBs and LRS are revised in later Bulletins; external debt is provisional for a quarter, then partially revised.
meta.coverage: Foreign exchange reserves every week since April 2001: foreign currency assets, gold, SDRs, IMF position, in dollars, and gold in tonnes
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 574 (Weekly Statistical Supplement table 2), week-ending Fridays. US$ million, ₹ crore, SDR million as published; gold volume in tonnes. A week's change mixes RBI's market operations with revaluation: gold and non-dollar currencies are valued in dollars at market prices. Besides the Fridays, RBI reports reserves as on 31 March each year and on a few holiday-shifted dates; those dates are kept.
